end.summary:
Practised factorising x² + px + q by finding two numbers with the required product and sum.
Correctly identified common factor 3 in 6x + 9 and checked by expansion.
Completed 2 of 4 factorisation attempts without help.
The coefficient-copying error in x² + 5x + 6 remained at the latest sighting; teach-back was not passed.
end.parentNote: Arjun practised using the product-and-sum method and checked factors by multiplying the brackets back out. They explained the common factor method clearly and later matched −3 and +2 to product −6 and sum −1. They still mixed up the coefficients with the factor numbers in x² + 5x + 6, and this was not corrected by the end. At home, ask them to write the target product and sum first, then test two numbers and expand the brackets to check.
